phase.description: Monoclinic beta model, not a synthesis claim.

site.description: Al octahedral; Ga tetrahedral, Fig. 1 also inspected.

concentration.description: Model cation fraction x=0.5; not dilute doping.

limitations: Primary author manuscript arXiv:1806.03360v2 associated with journal DOI; no new DFT run.

reviewed_claims.scope: STEM-observed Re occupying Mo sites in single-layer MoS2; adatoms also observed.
reviewed_claims.label: documented_positive

reported_concentration.basis: Figure 1 counts about 10 Re per about 1500 MoS2 unit cells; retained as reported, no conversion to all-atom fraction

phase.description: Bulk 2H space group/Wyckoff identity in legacy record not established for this single-layer observation.

site.description: Mo-site occupation directly imaged, not every Re atom substitutional.
anchors: clearly shows that Re atoms sit at the Mo sites.

concentration.description: Reported approximately 0.6 at%, source convention retained.

limitations: Full contextual benchmark held; useful site-occupancy reference only.
Reported 89% substitutional Re and 11% Re adatoms are microscopy population statistics, not MATRA accuracy.
Donor interpretation uses calculated electronic states; experimental electrical activation not established here.

reviewed_claims.scope: Nb-doped SrTiO3 single crystals; representative reported 0.1 wt% sample, nominal SrTi0.998Nb0.002O3.
reviewed_claims.label: documented_positive

reported_concentration.basis: Mass of elemental Nb / total sample mass times 100; nominal formulas separately reported

anchors: Nb-doped SrTiO3 single crystals with Nb doping concentration

phase.description: Temperature-dependent transition investigated; exact phase-specific benchmark conditions require additional curation.

site.description: Nominal Ti substitution and ionic-radius interpretation; direct site-occupancy refinement not established in selected passage.

concentration.description: 0.1 wt% sample; Methods defines mass basis and lists nominal formulas.

limitations: Nominal chemistry is not independently measured site occupancy.
No wt%-to-at% substitution, no generic room/low-temperature phase equivalence.
Correct DOI differs from initial retrieval candidate and from legacy unrelated citation.

reviewed_claims.label: documented_positive
reviewed_claims.scope: Bridgman-Stockbarger Bi2Te2Se crystal, room-temperature powder XRD model with Se primarily on inner chalcogen 3a sites and minor outer 6c mixing.

reported_concentration.basis: Nominal Se/(Te+Se) chalcogen-sublattice fraction for Bi2Te2Se; not fraction of all atoms

host.description: Bi2Te3-related tetradymite solid-solution family; investigated sample is Bi2Te2Se.

phase.description: Rhombohedral tetradymite-type layering; powder XRD collected at room temperature, not the 4 K transport state.

site.description: Table I: inner 3a Se occupancy 0.915(14), outer 6c Se occupancy 0.043(7); no perfect-order assumption.

concentration.description: Nominal 2:1 Te:Se model, checked against reported occupancy table.
anchors: with a 2:1 ratio of Te to Se

limitations: One specific composition/preparation and structural observation; no full-composition-range claim.
Source also reports phase separation for differently processed samples; these are not interchangeable.
No independently validated preservation of band gap, stability or thermoelectric performance; no held-out evaluation.
Occupancy factors are refinement-model estimates, not independent bulk elemental analysis.

unscored_observations.scope: XAS model supports preferential octahedral Ga2-site Sn in beta-Ga2O3 single crystal.

passages.description: EXAFS site alternatives and fitting residuals.
anchors: tion at the Ga2 octahedral site

limitations: Specific Sn concentration of the XAS crystal is not tied to an exact tabulated value in reviewed text; figure points were not digitized.
EXAFS R-factor is a spectral fit residual, not model accuracy.

unscored_observations.scope: Amorphous ALD film with substantial Sn content remains highly resistive; this is not a negative label for all Sn in Ga2O3.

passages.description: Sn concentration estimate and limited electrical detection.
